data.name: Lootspire
data.detailed_description:
Lootspire is a co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Climb procedurally generated spire floors, gear up with loot that transforms your abilities, and see how deep your party can push before the ever-escalating danger overwhelms you.

Gear Changes Everything

Equipment isn't just stat sticks. Items alter how your abilities behave through a tag-based modifier system — a single piece of gear might make your projectiles chain between enemies, turn a ground slam into a burning zone, or split your arrows into a fan. Every run builds differently based on what you find.

Climb Together

Play solo or bring up to 3 friends via Steam online co-op. Every floor spawns more enemies, hits harder, and pushes your party closer to the edge. Trade gear with your party, pick level-up bonuses in safe zones between floors, then ready up and dive back in.

Multiple Classes, Countless Builds

Each class comes with a unique passive, multiple abilities, a movement ability, and an ultimate. Each classes ability are interchangeable before the run.  With 20 classes planned across the game's development, the ability pool keeps growing — and every class shares from the same pool, as long as your prefered main weapon matches.

The Spire Never Stops

Floors are procedurally generated with branching rooms, corridors, and side chambers. A danger system steadily ramps enemy spawn rates and intensity the longer you stay. Boss encounters await every 10 floors. Difficulty scales exponentially — runs naturally last 30–60 minutes, and most parties won't survive past floor 20. Gear resets every run, only spire currencies carry over to fuel permanent progression.

Multiple Spires, New Challenges

Each spire introduces distinct environmental mechanics and enemy types. Sand pits that slow your movement, crumbling floors that reshape the battlefield, destructible terrain that opens shortcuts — the spire you choose changes how you play, not just what you fight.

Early Access

Lootspire is in active development. The current build includes 4 playable classes, full online co-op, procedural dungeon generation, the loot and modifier system, boss fights, meta-progression, and a leveling system with choices between floors. More classes, spires, enemies, and events are planned throughout Early Access.

data.short_description: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core (Intel i3 / AMD Athlon)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Vulkan 1.0 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core+ (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / RX 460)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
